builder.selection_rule: for each source family: VAL members inside the training native-pixel cap with the richest band count (S2=10, Landsat=7), smallest native side then id, up to two per family; A = frozen rectangle rule at P; B1 single = the two bands with the lowest and highest measured SRF-weighted centroid wavelength; B1 multi = cyclic consecutive windows of length k over that order for every k in 2..C-1; each case leaves at least one visible band
